scope: Planning only; no store implementation started by this package revision.

version_map.V1: currently live storefront; protect until explicitly authorized launch
version_map.V3: new redesign; package revision 3.1.0; implementation not started

completion_rule: Only verified after acceptance evidence, commit and applicable draft preview are recorded. A mockup or package file is not implementation evidence.

phases.title: Baseline, V1 protection and V2 recovery
phases.exit: V1 remains untouched; V2 can be restored; the first V3 work is isolated and reproducible.

phases.title: Catalog, content and media preparation
phases.exit: Every current SKU, real option, label, route and required merchant input has an explicit source.

phases.title: New V3 foundation and shared shell
phases.exit: Fresh V3 primitives, responsive shell and accessible overlays work with real data and no legacy fabricated fallbacks.

phases.title: Catalog browsing and search
phases.exit: Visitors can find, narrow and compare actual products and retain browsing context.

phases.title: Product detail and all-SKU completion
phases.exit: Every known product identity has correct current media, options, price, warnings and purchase states.

phases.title: Cart engine, drawer, page and visual recommendations
phases.exit: All mutations reconcile to Shopify without page reload; drawer and full cart agree and recommendation controls work.

phases.title: Homepage and product-led visual polish
phases.exit: Homepage A direction is complete with product-filled imagery and moderate lower-page spacing.

phases.title: Routine quiz and product-discovery results
phases.exit: Accessible quiz has reviewed eligibility or honest browse fallback, no email gate and no medical scoring.

phases.title: Journal and article system
phases.exit: Native editorial browsing and reading work with approved content and distinct imagery.

phases.title: Brand, support and operational pages
phases.exit: All planned informational pages and forms are complete or explicitly gated on merchant input.

phases.title: Accounts, subscriptions and checkout handoffs
phases.exit: Actual Shopify capabilities are respected and conditional programs cannot advertise unconfigured offers.

phases.title: Whole-store QA and content readiness
phases.exit: Functional, visual, responsive, accessibility, performance and data acceptance evidence is recorded.

phases.title: Draft releases, review and launch handoff
phases.exit: A reviewed V3 draft has reproducible source and rollback; live publish remains an explicit user decision.

tasks.title: Record version boundaries and protected live target
inputs: shopify.theme.toml and actual current Git/Shopify state
deliverables: A written record of the live store, existing draft and planned redesign.
acceptance: V1 remains live and protected. V2 is the existing partial draft, theme 189659021621. V3 is planned work; package revision 3.1.0 does not mean it is implemented.

tasks.title: Capture recoverable V2 source and configuration snapshot
inputs: shopify.theme.toml and actual current Git/Shopify state
deliverables: A recoverable snapshot of the actual V2 draft and relevant configuration.
acceptance: Save the current remote draft before replacing its sections. Record the backup, Git checkpoint and restoration procedure without creating another remote theme.

tasks.title: Isolate the V3 implementation branch and environment
inputs: shopify.theme.toml and actual current Git/Shopify state
deliverables: An isolated implementation branch and verified draft environment.
acceptance: Preserve user changes and confirm the draft target. Documentation-only changes do not trigger a Shopify deployment.

tasks.title: Establish build checks and iteration evidence template
inputs: shopify.theme.toml and actual current Git/Shopify state
deliverables: Baseline checks and a repeatable iteration report.
acceptance: Record existing failures separately. Each implementation batch has checks, a commit and, when deployed, a matching draft preview.

tasks.title: Audit current products, variants and markets
deliverables: A current Shopify catalog and variant audit.
acceptance: Resolve actual IDs, options, prices, markets and availability. Compare all 16 known identities; the public research snapshot is not a runtime database.

tasks.title: Verify labels, warnings, directions and product formats
deliverables: A current label and approved content checklist for each SKU.
acceptance: Directions, warnings, ingredients and media match the actual product. Preserve third-party branding; no generated facts table or copied directions.

tasks.title: Map original media and approve product-filled variants
deliverables: An approved slot and crop map for original media and product-filled variants.
acceptance: Products are visible in intended B-roll. Check packaging against original sources and never layer additional bottles over an already product-filled image.

tasks.title: Resolve low-resolution Secretropin source
deliverables: A better authentic Secretropin source or a documented limited gallery.
acceptance: Do not upscale the 265 × 503 source into a large hero. Confirm readable required label media before that SKU is launch-ready.

tasks.title: Configure real collections, goal fields and filters
deliverables: Actual collection destinations and configured goal/format filters.
acceptance: Every menu destination exists. Only configured facets appear; product membership is deliberate rather than inferred from a name.

tasks.title: Confirm shipping, returns, contact and wholesale inputs
deliverables: Approved operational information and a record of unresolved inputs.
acceptance: Do not assume shipping thresholds, refund terms, support response times or wholesale eligibility.

tasks.title: Approve navigation, legacy URL preservation and editorial plan
deliverables: Approved navigation, legacy URL mapping and first-article plan.
acceptance: Keep existing product handles or record real redirects. Authors, reviewers and editorial approvals are real.

tasks.title: Implement fresh V3 tokens and typography
deliverables: A fresh scoped V3 token and typography implementation.
acceptance: Follow the specified colors, spacing and type. Phone body text remains 16px; old V2 CSS and fabricated data fallbacks are not copied.

tasks.title: Implement new V3 buttons, forms, icons and accordions
deliverables: Accessible buttons, inputs, icons and accordions.
acceptance: Controls have usable targets and visible focus. Labels and validation are persistent; individual products remain open on white.

tasks.title: Implement desktop header and real navigation
deliverables: A new desktop header and actual navigation menus.
acceptance: Logo proportions remain correct. Destinations resolve, submenus work by keyboard, and no empty program appears.

tasks.title: Implement phone header, menu and overlay controller
deliverables: Phone navigation and a shared modal controller.
acceptance: Escape, close and focus return work. Lock background scrolling, handle safe areas and prevent overlapping modals.

tasks.title: Implement footer, newsletter and policy links
deliverables: A responsive footer, actual newsletter handler and policy links.
acceptance: Phone fields stack. Only confirmed server success displays success; omit unverified social links and promises.

tasks.title: Implement responsive media and page-level layout primitives
deliverables: Responsive media and layout primitives.
acceptance: Use correct image sizes and intrinsic dimensions. Prioritize the hero, lazy-load below-fold images, and preserve readable lower-page spacing at 320px.

tasks.title: Implement open product item and real money/availability
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: An open product item component using actual commerce data.
acceptance: Original media, current price and availability are accurate. Long titles wrap; no synthetic review badge or enclosing card.

tasks.title: Implement Shop All desktop and mobile
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: The complete Shop All template.
acceptance: Use real counts, sorting and pagination, three desktop columns and two phone columns. The masthead uses its own product-filled asset.

tasks.title: Implement category/goal collection family
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: Category and goal collection pages.
acceptance: Each collection has the correct scope and destination. Missing photography uses the designed text-first masthead rather than borrowed filler.

tasks.title: Implement native filters, applied overview and mobile sheet
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: Native filtering, applied selections and a phone filter sheet.
acceptance: Selections survive browsing history. Clear and cancel work; zero results preserve context and offer recovery.

tasks.title: Implement search results and zero-result states
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: Search results and no-result layouts.
acceptance: Submit real queries, separate resource types and keep the query editable. Empty results do not invent products.

tasks.title: Implement predictive search and keyboard selection
inputs: Current published collections/products and configured filters
deliverables: Predictive search with accessible keyboard selection.
acceptance: Ignore stale responses. Escape and ordinary submission work when enhancement fails.

tasks.title: Implement PDP gallery, thumbnails and label viewer
inputs: Current approved variant labels, options, availability and content
deliverables: A product media gallery with thumbnails and readable label viewer.
acceptance: Use the current product and variant media. Zoom and focus return work; a missing label stays honestly unavailable.

tasks.title: Implement variant, price, quantity and product form
inputs: Current approved variant labels, options, availability and content
deliverables: A product form bound to real selected variants.
acceptance: Price, media and options synchronize. Submit the actual variant ID and quantity; unavailable combinations cannot be purchased.

tasks.title: Implement PDP content modules and responsive lower page
inputs: Current approved variant labels, options, availability and content
deliverables: Responsive product information, routine, usage, FAQ and related-item modules.
acceptance: Use approved product-specific content. Phone editorial blocks stack; related items exclude the current product.

tasks.title: Remove all fabricated commerce and review fallbacks
inputs: Current approved variant labels, options, availability and content
deliverables: A V3 source audit for fabricated commerce data.
acceptance: No seeded review counts or averages, synthetic discount price, or unconfigured subscription offer remains.

tasks.title: Validate purchase and display across format families
inputs: Current approved variant labels, options, availability and content
deliverables: Verification across powder, capsule, softgel, spray and lozenge families.
acceptance: Each family uses its own directions, warnings, labels and purchase controls; no powder instructions leak into other products.

tasks.title: Build single shared Ajax cart mutation coordinator
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: A single shared Ajax cart coordinator.
acceptance: Use real variant IDs and line keys with locale-aware endpoints. Serialize cart mutations; successful enhanced actions do not reload or navigate the document.

tasks.title: Build coordinated cart sections and partial-render recovery
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: A shared contract for cart sections and recovery.
acceptance: Update cart lines, header count, summary and recommendations from authoritative state. Null section HTML triggers a read/render recovery, never a second add.

tasks.title: Implement populated desktop cart drawer
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: The populated desktop drawer.
acceptance: Cart lines and checkout remain usable within a 440–480px panel. Keep the drawer open, retain focus and preserve scroll position after updates.

tasks.title: Implement phone cart drawer and safe-area behavior
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: The phone drawer layout and behavior.
acceptance: Use a full-width sheet with safe-area padding and usable controls. Recommendations must not obscure checkout or require tiny taps.

tasks.title: Implement standalone full cart page
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: A complete standalone cart page.
acceptance: Desktop and phone layouts support real totals, discounts, quantities and removal. Ajax enhancement updates in place; a normal form remains the no-JS fallback.

tasks.title: Implement recommendation source and eligibility rules
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: A recommendation candidate source and eligibility filter.
acceptance: Use merchant curation or supported product recommendations. Exclude unavailable, unpublished, restricted and already-in-cart products; hide an empty module.

tasks.title: Implement visual recommendation item and inline variant choice
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: Visual recommendation rows and inline option selection.
acceptance: Show original packshot, name, real price and action. Multiple variants require a deliberate valid selection; never silently pick the wrong option.

tasks.title: Wire recommendation add without reloading
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: Recommendation adds connected to the shared cart.
acceptance: Add one selected variant, update the cart, count, subtotal and candidate pool in place, and announce success. Keep the same URL and prevent duplicate submissions.

tasks.title: Implement empty cart page and drawer recommendations
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: Empty page and drawer states with visual starters.
acceptance: Do not enable checkout for an empty bag. Adding a starter changes the same surface to populated without a document reload.

tasks.title: Handle rapid actions, inventory conflicts and failure recovery
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: Recovery for rapid actions, stock conflicts and unknown outcomes.
acceptance: Do not apply stale state or reuse obsolete line keys. Reconcile the cart after uncertain writes before offering a retry; recommendation errors do not break checkout.

tasks.title: Verify cart consistency and no-reload network evidence
inputs: Current Shopify cart/variant data and merchant-approved recommendation candidates
deliverables: An end-to-end cart verification record.
acceptance: Drawer, cart page and header agree. Record network evidence of no successful document navigation and test empty transitions, quantities, currency, discounts and focus.

tasks.title: Implement homepage hero and product-filled responsive media
inputs: Current native collections and published editorial content
deliverables: The homepage hero with product-filled responsive artwork.
acceptance: Use A15/A16 or an approved original-layer composition. Keep headline and actions as HTML; do not add duplicate products over the filled images.

tasks.title: Implement featured category/product swapper
inputs: Current native collections and published editorial content
deliverables: The working featured-product category swapper.
acceptance: Keyboard and no-JS navigation work. Real prices and honest featured/bestseller labels remain correct through loading, empty and error states.

tasks.title: Implement goal discovery and standards section
inputs: Current native collections and published editorial content
deliverables: Four goal destinations and the standards section.
acceptance: Use A24/A25/A26 and A06, plus the dedicated standards variant. No repeated filler; phone layouts follow the moderate spacing scale.

tasks.title: Implement routine CTA, native journal preview and signup
inputs: Current native collections and published editorial content
deliverables: The routine CTA, actual blog previews and newsletter.
acceptance: Avoid duplicate quiz prompts. Missing article art uses the designed text-first preview; signup reports real results.

tasks.title: Review complete homepage at all target widths
inputs: Current native collections and published editorial content
deliverables: A complete homepage review at every target width.
acceptance: The middle and lower page feel relaxed without empty bands. Categories, shopping links and cart interactions work.

tasks.title: Approve nonmedical quiz options and eligibility inputs
deliverables: Reviewed quiz options and product eligibility, or a disabled decision.
acceptance: Do not ask for diagnosis, medication or email. Production matching remains disabled until its rules are reviewed.

tasks.title: Implement quiz entry and accessible question flow
deliverables: An accessible three-step quiz.
acceptance: Progress, fieldsets, radio choices, Back and Continue work with retained answers. Use the product-filled entry image and no email gate.

tasks.title: Implement reviewed matches, no-match and browse fallback
deliverables: Results, no-match and browse fallback states.
acceptance: Show eligible available individual products with understandable reasons. Missing rules lead to real browsing rather than invented matches.

tasks.title: Verify quiz analytics/privacy and optional follow-up
deliverables: A privacy and analytics verification record for the quiz.
acceptance: Do not attach answers silently to email signup. Edit and reset work; no sensitive fields are collected by default.

tasks.title: Prepare approved native blog/articles and taxonomy
deliverables: Approved native editorial content and taxonomy.
acceptance: Do not publish generated mockup prose as researched medical content. Any displayed author or reviewer is real.

tasks.title: Implement journal index, topics and pagination
deliverables: The journal index, topic filtering and pagination.
acceptance: Use actual articles and A22 for the example feature. Text-first rows replace missing unique thumbnails.

tasks.title: Implement article layout, contents and product context
deliverables: The article reading layout and contextual links.
acceptance: Use readable measure, working contents anchors and A23 for the example article. Product and author metadata come from real sources.

tasks.title: Verify long, short, missing-image and unpublished articles
deliverables: Verification of article and blog edge cases.
acceptance: Check long and short content, no image, no author, zero articles and unpublished URLs. Anchors are not hidden by the sticky header.

tasks.title: Implement About and standards information pages
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: The About and standards pages.
acceptance: Use A14 only where assigned. Company facts, report links and standards claims are approved; no invented clinical authority.

tasks.title: Implement contact form and support channels
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: The contact form and support links.
acceptance: Persistent labels and real validation preserve messages after failure. No fake contact details or delivery confirmation.

tasks.title: Implement categorized FAQ content and deep links
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: Approved FAQ groups and deep links.
acceptance: Questions wrap naturally. Product-specific safety or dosing answers are not generalized; accordions work by keyboard.

tasks.title: Implement shipping/returns and canonical policy surfaces
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: Current shipping, returns and canonical policy layouts.
acceptance: Summary and policy agree. No assumed threshold, guarantee or substitute legal text is published.

tasks.title: Implement wholesale inquiry and operational handoff
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: A professional wholesale inquiry flow.
acceptance: Connect a real handler. Do not promise automatic approval, discount tiers or response times.

tasks.title: Implement 404 and missing-resource recovery
inputs: Merchant-approved brand/support/legal content and actual form destinations
deliverables: A correct 404 recovery page.
acceptance: Return the correct status, retain usable search and real category links, and do not conceal missing routes with automatic redirects.

tasks.title: Inspect actual account and checkout configuration
inputs: Actual Shopify account, checkout and selling-plan configuration
deliverables: An actual account/checkout capability record.
acceptance: Inspect configured account mode and customization entitlement. No unsupported custom login or Liquid checkout is assumed.
file_targets: Actual Shopify account/checkout and selling-plan surfaces

tasks.title: Implement account entry and native return journeys
inputs: Actual Shopify account, checkout and selling-plan configuration
deliverables: Native account entry and return journeys.
acceptance: Use actual account routes. Do not collect credentials in a custom theme form; verify phone signed-in and signed-out access.
file_targets: Actual Shopify account/checkout and selling-plan surfaces

tasks.title: Decide subscription scope from actual selling plans
inputs: Actual Shopify account, checkout and selling-plan configuration
deliverables: A subscription enable/disable decision based on actual plans.
acceptance: Use real allocation prices and provider terms. Missing plans hide the program instead of generating a fixed discount.
file_targets: Actual Shopify account/checkout and selling-plan surfaces

tasks.title: Implement eligible subscription information/controls only if enabled
inputs: Actual Shopify account, checkout and selling-plan configuration
deliverables: Conditional subscription information and purchase controls.
acceptance: When enabled, use real plan IDs, schedules and prices. Preserve separate cart lines for distinct plans; otherwise verify the hidden state.
file_targets: Actual Shopify account/checkout and selling-plan surfaces

tasks.title: Verify checkout and order confirmation handoff in test mode
inputs: Actual Shopify account, checkout and selling-plan configuration
deliverables: A test-mode checkout and order confirmation verification.
acceptance: Check shipping/address/payment errors and real confirmation. No real charge by default and no synthetic successful-order page.
file_targets: Actual Shopify account/checkout and selling-plan surfaces

tasks.title: Run real-width full-store visual and spacing review
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: A whole-store visual review matrix.
acceptance: Review 320, 360, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440px. Eliminate cramped lower sections, overflow, tiny desktop columns and excessive blank bands.

tasks.title: Run keyboard, screen reader and overlay acceptance
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: Keyboard, assistive technology and reflow evidence.
acceptance: Verify menu, filters, gallery, cart, quiz and forms; visible focus, useful announcements and reduced-motion behavior.

tasks.title: Run commerce regression and no-reload recommendation tests
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: Commerce regression and no-reload recommendation evidence.
acceptance: Test add/change/remove, variants, plans, stock, discounts and timeouts. Same-URL Ajax updates do not duplicate items and never rely on static research prices.

tasks.title: Verify search, filters, history and no-JS fallbacks
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: Search, filter, history and no-JS evidence.
acceptance: Restore context after product browsing. Ordinary links and forms remain usable when enhancement fails.

tasks.title: Optimize media, loading and performance budgets
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: Media and runtime performance measurements.
acceptance: Use selected responsive derivatives, not every master. Record loading/layout stability and an appropriate lab baseline plus field-measurement plan.

tasks.title: Audit content, links, metadata, indexing and approved analytics
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: A final content, link and metadata audit.
acceptance: No fabricated reviews, offers or claims; actual product/currency values and preserved canonical destinations.
Approved analytics and consent settings are preserved or deliberately reconnected; a test shopping journey does not emit duplicate add-to-cart events after section replacement.

tasks.title: Close merchant decisions or explicitly gate unavailable modules
inputs: Actual completed V3 implementation and recorded task evidence
deliverables: A closed decision register or safe gating of unresolved modules.
acceptance: Do not declare launch readiness while an unresolved business or media requirement is silently bypassed.

tasks.title: Prepare reviewable draft release candidate
inputs: Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: A reproducible review candidate with recovery checkpoint.
acceptance: All required acceptance evidence and SKU checks pass; source, checks and rollback record identify the same candidate.

tasks.title: Push source and update only the existing unpublished draft
inputs: Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: A source checkpoint pushed before updating the existing draft.
acceptance: Verify theme 189659021621 and use the normal draft command. Do not use --unpublished or publish live.

tasks.title: Run post-push preview smoke tests and merchant review
inputs: Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: Post-deployment preview smoke tests and merchant review.
acceptance: Confirm the deployed preview matches the commit and test desktop/phone navigation, PDP, recommendations, bag and checkout handoff.

tasks.title: Record V3 acceptance and remaining rollout decisions
inputs: Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: Merchant acceptance or clearly scoped follow-up tasks.
acceptance: Review feedback becomes discrete tasks with evidence. No automatic promotion to live.

tasks.title: Publish V3 only after explicit live-publish instruction
inputs: Explicit user authorization to publish live
Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: An explicitly authorized V3 launch.
acceptance: Wait for a direct user instruction to publish live. Preserve V1 recovery and use an approved launch/rollback plan.

tasks.title: Verify production and close rollout
inputs: Existing unpublished draft 189659021621 and recoverable source checkpoints
deliverables: Production verification and final handover.
acceptance: Verify the published theme and customer journeys; record monitoring and recovery ownership.
